_comment: Canonical EN->RU terms handed to the engine to enforce. Matched case-insensitively as whole words; only terms occurring in a unit are sent. Yandex applies them via its native glossary with exact:false, so it DECLINES each term to fit Russian grammar; LM Studio gets them in the prompt with the same instruction. Declinable terms are therefore fine — give the dictionary (nominative) form as the RU value (e.g. Sect->секта, Martial Art->боевое искусство) and the engine inflects it. Bump GLOSSARY_VERSION in src/config/glossary.ts after edits to re-translate affected units. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
